articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed, avg 12 published/cycle (56 yesterday)

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active and there is no pause gate. Every target is met except same-event duplicates, and no tunable parameter can fix that one. Science reached 6 against 5 from four outlets, including Nature.
weakestArea: There is one same-event duplicate. Two 404 Media stories cover the same Google patent for a personalised AI TV channel: "Google Patents Personal AI Channel" and "Google Patents Personalised AI Channel". They came from different URLs on the same outlet and their titles differ by one word, so neither the URL dedup layer nor the exact-title 72h gate in validate-articles.js caught them. Fixing this means a fuzzy-title or same-outlet-same-subject check in the pipeline code, which is outside daily tuning, so the operator should handle it. One of the two should be removed.
watching: Hormuz and the Gulf: crossings are down 40%, oil is sliding toward a glut, and Qatar is pressing Iran–US talks while the Houthis hit a Riyadh tower again.
Iraq: Baghdad seized Kurdish oilfields and disputes its OPEC+ capacity.
Nigeria: the NDC boycotted a police meeting and police are hunting executives ahead of the election.
Colombia: a car bomb in Villavicencio, a hostage-taking in Cartagena, and a request to X to ban Petro.
Trade: Trump readies new tariffs and the US blacklisted an Alibaba unit.
Solomon Islands dropped its China security pact, a rare Oceania story to follow.
coverageGaps: Seven datelines are bare country or region names ("United States" ×6, "United Arab Emirates", "China", "Germany", "East Asia") rather than cities.
Europe had only 7 datelines (11%), down from 13 yesterday.
Tech is 17 of 61 (28%) and still leans on Chinese tech press (Zhidx ×4, TMTPost, TechNode).
context: This is the fourth straight day with all five cycles completed, averaging 1090s, with the selector at 153s, the writer at 147s and the editor at 76s. Multi-source (33%), US datelines (23%) and Latin America (8%) have now held their targets for several days without any experiment, so no tunable is under pressure. One story was quarantined, and one Qatar/Iran story has only state or advocacy sources.
